title: Even Odd Tree
summary: An Even-Odd binary tree must have nodes at even levels with odd values in increasing order, and nodes at odd levels with even values in decreasing order, starting from the root at level 0.
statement: An Even-Odd binary tree must have nodes at even levels with odd values in increasing order, and nodes at odd levels with even values in decreasing order, starting from the root at level 0.
constraints: Even-indexed levels require strictly increasing odd values; odd-indexed levels require strictly decreasing even values.
